subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose resetSessionEntryLifecycle and the locked-harness reset handoff as a public Plugin SDK contract for externally observed channel lifecycle boundaries?
rationale: The Teams fix is well-supported, but the branch promotes a new session-ownership operation into the third-party Plugin SDK; tests cannot decide whether that API boundary and its semantics are the long-term product contract.

options.title: Approve the scoped SDK contract
options.body: Accept the generic owner-checked reset operation and harness handoff, then refresh and merge the proven Teams implementation.

options.title: Keep lifecycle reset internal
options.body: Preserve the Teams behavior while redesigning the reset primitive as an internal or narrower owner-specific seam rather than public Plugin SDK API.

options.title: Pause the lifecycle fix
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers settle session ownership semantics, avoiding a public contract that may need incompatible revision.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the generic owner-checked reset operation and harness handoff, then refresh and merge the proven Teams implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the personal-chat scope refinement and are the strongest available owner signal for the unresolved contract choice.
